body: Tested 2026-11-19 from a non-Indian cloud IP. Reachable: Vahan analytics public dashboard (analytics.parivahan.gov.in; maker-wise tables need JSF AJAX/ViewState replay; the older vahan4dashboard resets, probably a geo-block), FADA monthly retail PDFs (fada.in/press-release-list.php), SIAM, National Power Portal npp.gov.in (daily generation by source and daily coal stocks), CEA, PPAC fuel consumption (product- and state-wise; diesel/bitumen/ATF as activity proxies), tradestat.commerce.gov.in (HS-code trade), Google Play pages (install buckets such as 100M+ plus rating counts), Google Trends daily RSS. Blocked from a foreign IP or throttled: Grid-India/POSOCO, e-way bill portal, IPA ports, JPC steel, data.gov.in API, NPCI (403), www.gst.gov.in root, Google Trends explore API (429). eaindustry.nic.in (core sector incl. cement/steel) has a broken TLS chain. Conclusion: exchange filings give most of the value and are fully scriptable. Sector alt-data is worth it mainly for autos (Vahan/FADA retail vs SIAM wholesale shows channel stuffing), power, fuel and exporters. Run government-portal fetches from an Indian residential IP.
title: Indian public alternative data - what is reachable (tested Nov 2026)
